description: Score two signs 0-100 with the published rule: element base (same 80; fire-air 85; earth-water 85; fire-earth 45; fire-water 40; earth-air 50; air-water 55), modality same -5 / different +5, no modality adjustment for a sign with itself (same sign = 75), clamp and round; symmetric. Bands: 80+ strong, 65-79 good, 50-64 mixed, <50 challenging. Returns score, band, verdict (one line per band), elements, modalities, method_url '/guides/how-compatibility-is-scored', page_url. Case-insensitive; Hindi sign names accepted. Example input: {"sign_a":"Aries","sign_b":"Leo"}
name: check_compatibility
